$comment: BEXT-02 (P68-39): Gecko add-ons pre-installed through <GreD>/distribution/extensions/<id>.xpi (macOS Contents/Resources/distribution/extensions/), staged unmodified by powerbrowser/packaging/stage-bundled-xpi.sh. Gecko installs each one into the profile once, with no network, and never reinstalls one the user removed (extensions.installedDistroAddon.<id>). There is deliberately no ExtensionSettings policy entry: its force_installed and normal_installed modes stop the user removing the add-on. A bump changes version, url and sha256 together; the sha256 is of the AMO-signed file the url serves. Checked by scripts/verify-bundled-xpi.mjs.
